title: Zest’s new AI agent finds restaurants and books reservations over text
hook_before: Zest launched an AI agent that finds restaurants and handles reservations over text.
script:
Zest just replaced your dining concierge service. It finds restaurants and books reservations via text.
You send a text to the concierge to start the process.
The AI aggregates preferences from your group to identify suitable dining options.
It puts those restaurant choices to a vote among your friends.
Once the group decides, the system automatically books the reservation for you.
This concierge replaces the manual back and forth of finding a place to eat.
Would you let an AI pick your next Friday night dinner?

editor.one_line: Strong, concise script, but visual repetition and static frames hurt the premium feel.
script_fixes: LINE 6: Change 'This concierge' to 'Zest' to avoid generic phrasing and reinforce the brand name.
